prior_failure_observations.name: six recovery defects and four Windows trace aliases
post-launch publication, loading window and guard-budget interactions
automatic settlement before manual verification returned
terminal state-commit retry and atomic journal publication

controlled_boundaries: All declared health endpoints must answer; process creation alone is not repair.
Sustained faults, cooldown, three automatic launch attempts per unresolved incident and measured healthy reset.
Shared auto/manual state ownership, no launcher-state loss, one launch attempt record.
Durable intent before Popen; reservation failure prevents launch; later result/log failure retains intent.
Runtime in-flight protection covers the 300-second observation window.
Guard/port refusal does not consume launch budget; two concurrent manual callers launch only once.
Attempt tokens prevent double settlement and obsolete observers from clearing a new launch.
Atomic journal publication and stable event IDs preserve first terminal outcome across failed state commits.
Corrupt JSON, duplicate fields and invalid counters/times/flags are preserved and rejected.
Explicit HTTP recovery result follows verified health.
Exact chain selection, no retained API results, cross-process ownership, atomic records and owner marker cleanup.
limits: Controlled probes and launcher doubles, not live model-service fault injection.
Not an installed-wheel acceptance or a change to frozen v0.4.8 assets.
Legacy loaded processes do not necessarily participate in the new ownership protocol.
Atomic individual files do not imply an atomic state-and-log reader snapshot or crash-exactly-once log.
Reboot/logon and a clean 24-hour observation remain pending; failure history is retained.
